releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.5.0 — Complete UI Overhaul & Rebuild:
• Streamlined Navigation: Replaced 9 fragmented tabs with 5 clean, intuitive master hubs:
  1. [📊 Dashboard] (Overview, Gauges, Quick Action Tiles, Live Rolling Thermals & Forensics)
  2. [🎮 Gaming & GPU] (Clock Profiles, dGPU Power Gate, Refresh Rate, Tri-Pillar, Game Focus, DWM Bypass, Micro-Thread, DirectX Pipeline, DDA)
  3. [⚡ Fans & Power] (OmniNeural Multi-Agent, Fan Curves, Power Budget Ratio, SMT Core Parking, Undervolt Safeguard, Battery Limiter)
  4. [🛠️ System Tools] (Storage Cleaner, Network Ping Optimizer, DPC Latency Watchdog, Startup Manager)
  5. [⚙️ Settings & Logs] (Themes Gallery, 5-Min Rolling Telemetry, General Settings, In-App Updater)
• Modular Sub-Category Viewports: Eliminated endless vertical scrolling with clean, responsive sub-category pills in every hub.
• Scrollable Update Dialog with fixed bottom buttons.
• Zero-Dependency Native Single-Binary Architecture (<15 MB RAM, <0.1% CPU).
